title: Vinci RAT Delivered Through a Malicious Microsoft Store App
description: In November 2026, a malicious Microsoft Store app named Setup Assistant was discovered distributing Vinci RAT, a PowerShell-based remote access trojan. The app, signed by Microsoft and published by ETPS Ltd, acted as a heavily obfuscated Electron backdoor maintaining command and control communication and monitoring the victim's Downloads folder. The infection started via redirection to a fake snipping tool website and used search-engine manipulation and fake download pages to lure victims. Vinci RAT provides extensive capabilities including host fingerprinting, security tool discovery, remote shell access, file delivery, and execution of various file types and shellcode.
